title: aralia longifolia
intro: Aralia longifolia, commonly known as the Chinese angelica tree or Chinese angelica, is a plant species in the Araliaceae family. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aralia longifolia include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include araloside, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
